description: P02 import codemod fixture matrix. Every required transformation class from the P02 prompt's tests 2 and 5 has at least one named case here, each with an explicit expected outcome (changed/unsafe/diagnostic kinds).

cases.name: simple_import
cases.description: Bare 'import runtime' plus a module-qualified usage runtime.pdf_inspect.something().

cases.name: aliased_import
cases.description: 'import runtime as rt'; alias usage (rt.pdf_inspect...) is untouched, only the import target changes.

cases.name: multiline_from_import
cases.description: Parenthesized multi-name from-import with a trailing inline comment; only the module path changes, parens/trailing comma/comment/indentation preserved verbatim.

cases.name: from_import_aliased_module
cases.description: 'from runtime.langgraph_factory import persistence as P'; only the from-import module path changes, P usage untouched.

cases.name: string_literal_non_target
cases.description: Ordinary string literals mentioning 'runtime' (prose and a path-shaped string) are never rewritten; only the real import statement changes.

cases.name: comment_non_target
cases.description: A comment mentioning 'runtime.pdf_inspect' is preserved verbatim; only the import and the real code usage change.

cases.name: dynamic_import_literal
cases.description: importlib.import_module('runtime.pdf_inspect') with a literal string argument: flagged as an actionable diagnostic, never rewritten (string content is not mutated).

cases.name: dynamic_import_computed
cases.description: importlib.import_module(name) with a computed (non-literal) argument: cannot be classified safely, unsafe diagnostic, file left unmodified (fail closed).

cases.name: ambiguous_shadowed_param
cases.description: A function parameter literally named 'runtime' with no package import in the file: explicit non-target, reported, untouched.

cases.name: ambiguous_shadowed_reassign
cases.description: 'import runtime' at module scope, then a local reassignment 'runtime = 5' inside a function shadows it; the import statement is rewritten but the shadowed local body is explicit non-target and untouched.

cases.name: already_migrated
cases.description: Input already fully using curriculum_factory: zero diagnostics, zero changes (also exercises the no-op/idempotent path directly).

cases.name: malformed_python
cases.description: Syntactically invalid Python: parse_error diagnostic, file skipped, no crash, unsafe (fails closed).

cases.name: mixed_old_new
cases.description: 'import runtime' and 'import curriculum_factory' both already present in one file referencing different symbols; after rewrite both target curriculum_factory, flagged as a duplicate-import warning for manual cleanup (semantically harmless, not blocked).

cases.name: relative_import_non_target
cases.description: 'from . import sibling' and 'from .runtime import helper' are both relative imports (never referencing the absolute production root); explicit non-targets, left untouched, zero diagnostics.

cases.name: unexpected_new_reference
cases.description: A file with an unexpected curriculum_factory reference not created by rewrite (checked only when check_unexpected_new_root is enabled in scan_residuals).
